statements.t: In May 2026, the Company approved a capital return program consisting of (i) a quarterly cash dividend, anticipated to commence in the fourth quarter of 2026, at an expected rate of $0.10 per ordinary share, and (ii) authorization for the repurchase of up to $50.0 million of the Company’s ordinary shares from time to time through open market transactions, privately negotiated transactions, or otherwise, at…

These capital allocation activities will be evaluated in the context of our overall liquidity position, operating requirements and strategic priorities.
